CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.

3. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

4. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

   C. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

9. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)

10. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.

11. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

14. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

15. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
